overview_description.description:
Better.com democratized the home-financing ecosystem, replacing it with a digitized process that eliminates commissions, fees, unnecessary steps, and time-wasting branch appointments. In addition to providing mortgage rates in seconds, Better.com’s platform offers a digital marketplace featuring competitive quotes from an array of insurance providers for the seamless purchase of a homeowner's insurance policy and instant access to leading real estate agents across the country.

To date, Better.com has done $7.9B in home loans and $1B in insurance.

press_references.value: Better Home & Finance Files Lawsuit Against Former CEO Vishal Garg to Protect Shareholders in the Face of Garg’s Blatant Misrepresentations and Violations of Federal Securities Laws

legal_proceedings.description: Better Home & Finance Holding Company filed a federal lawsuit against former CEO Vishal Garg in the Southern District of New York. The complaint alleges violations of Sections 13(d) and 14(a) of the Securities Exchange Act, including undisclosed coordination with shareholders and misleading solicitation communications. Better seeks declaratory and injunctive relief requiring corrective disclosures and an end to the alleged improper solicitation.

about_short_description.short_description: Better.com is a homeownership journey platform that utilizes technology to change the way people buy and own a home.

product.name: Better Mortgage
product.description: A direct-to-consumer digital mortgage lending service for home purchases, offering online applications, pre-approvals, underwriting, rate locking, and loan closing.

product.name: Better Refinance
product.description: An online mortgage refinancing service that replaces an existing home loan to adjust the interest rate, term, monthly payment, or available home equity.

product.name: Better HELOC
product.description: A home equity line of credit that lets eligible homeowners borrow against available equity, draw funds as needed, and repay over a designated term.

product.name: Better Real Estate
product.description: A real estate service that matches home buyers and sellers with agents and provides data-informed support during the offer and transaction process.

product.name: Better Cover
product.description: A homeowners insurance service that helps mortgage customers obtain dwelling and related property coverage through an online insurance platform.

product.name: Better Settlement Services
product.description: A title and settlement service that supports title searches, title insurance, closing coordination, and related transaction disbursements for mortgage borrowers.
